## Data & Software

### Data

Download the [Desert Pocket Mouse data](/data/pp_abundance_by_month.csv)

### Software Installation

These models are fit using [Stan](https://mc-stan.org/), which compiles each model to C++, so you need a working C++ toolchain in addition to the R packages.

1\. Install a C++ toolchain if you don't already have one:

* **Windows:** Install the version of [Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) that matches your version of R (e.g., Rtools45 for R 4.5.x). Check your R version by running `R.version.string`.
* **macOS:** Install Xcode's command line tools by running `xcode-select --install` in the Terminal. You don't need the full Xcode app from the App Store.
* **Linux:** Install `g++` and `make` using your distribution's package manager (e.g., `sudo apt install build-essential` on Ubuntu/Debian).

2\. Install cmdstanr:

```r
install.packages(
  "cmdstanr",
  repos = c('https://stan-dev.r-universe.dev', getOption("repos"))
)
```

3\. Install CmdStan (this can take several minutes):

```r
library(cmdstanr)
check_cmdstan_toolchain()
install_cmdstan()
```

If this fails try:

```r
check_cmdstan_toolchain(fix = TRUE)
install_cmdstan()
```

5\. Test to make sure the installation worked

```r
cmdstan_version()
```

If this returns a version number (e.g., "2.37.0") then the test passed.

```r
data(portal_data); mvgam(captures ~ 1, data = portal_data)
```

If this prints a bunch of output and no errors your all set!

If either fails try:

```r
check_cmdstan_toolchain(fix = TRUE)
install_cmdstan()
cmdstan_version()
```
